title: Freeze loop-control verifier design
goal: Freeze the smallest correct verifier design and executable acceptance surface for loop-control legality.
description: Scope: StyioIR verifier loop nesting and focused acceptance artifacts. Context: codegen rejects top-level break/continue, but the independent verifier currently inherits both as unchecked leaves. Target: specify balanced loop-context tracking for SGLoop, SGForEach, and SGRangeFor and explicit rejection for SGBreak/SGContinue outside those contexts. Design Considerations: prefer direct scoped state with exception-safe restoration; assess catalog patterns without adding speculative abstractions. Constraints & Risks: preserve the current single-level break contract; do not change parser, Sema, codegen behavior, IR ownership, or unrelated verifier leaves.
conditions: The design must prove valid nested loop control and invalid top-level loop control without broadening language semantics.

decisions.algorithms: single tree walk with constant-time loop-context checks
decisions.data_structures: one bounded loop-depth counter or equivalent scoped state
decisions.isolation: design artifacts only; production paths remain Worker-owned

test_seams: verify_styio_ir on synthetic top-level and nested-loop IR trees

acceptance_criteria.text: Architecture and validation artifacts freeze loop-context state, affected visitor methods, non-goals, failure diagnostics, and focused test cases.
The design_pattern_assessment compares the direct solution with applicable catalog patterns and justifies the smallest correct choice.

title: Enforce loop-control legality in the verifier
goal: Reject loop-control IR outside loop context and preserve valid nested loop traversal.
description: Scope: src/StyioIR/Verifier.cpp and focused verifier tests in tests/security/styio_security_test.cpp. Context: SGBreak and SGContinue are currently unchecked verifier leaves even though codegen requires a loop target. Target: maintain scoped loop depth during SGLoop, SGForEach, and SGRangeFor verification and emit the existing IR contract diagnostic family for invalid top-level break/continue. Design Considerations: use constant-space scoped state and preserve required-child traversal. Constraints & Risks: no parser, Sema, codegen, runtime, SGIR ownership, multi-level break, or unrelated verifier changes; do not retain compatibility paths.
conditions: Only verifier-local state and focused tests may change unless the frozen design identifies a strictly necessary implementation-local adjustment.

goal: Preserve strict final-root loop-control verification across intermediate lowering fragments.
description: Closure: scenario - intermediate loop-body fragment verification. Scope: src/StyioIR/Verifier.hpp, src/StyioIR/Verifier.cpp, src/StyioLowering/StyioIROptimizer.hpp, src/StyioLowering/StyioIROptimizer.cpp, and the intermediate SGBlock pipeline call sites in src/StyioLowering/AstToStyioIR.cpp. Context: the verifier correctly rejects zero-depth controls, but lowering verifies loop-body SGBlock fragments before their enclosing loop IR exists, causing three existing legal loop/codegen cases to fail. Target: defer only unresolved loop-control context for explicitly marked intermediate fragments while keeping fully assembled SGMainEntry verification strict before and after every pass. Design Considerations: use an explicit default-strict verifier/pipeline option; keep the O(N) traversal and O(1) state; do not infer context from root dynamic type or disable general structural verification. Design Value: preserves the fail-closed final contract without coupling verifier correctness to lowering construction order. Constraints & Risks: no parser, Sema, SGIR ownership, optimizer transformation, codegen/runtime, diagnostic text, multi-level control, global verification disable, or compatibility branch; final-root top-level rejection and existing legal loop cleanup/nearest-loop cases must both pass.

interfaces.outputs: structural diagnostics with loop-context deferral only for marked fragments

title: Validate the loop-control verifier closure
goal: Review the complete verifier closure once and run its full impacted regression once.
description: Scope: the bound compiler-correctness capability, changed verifier/test paths, and directly impacted security/codegen loop-control behavior. Context: group completion requires one end-to-end review followed by one full regression. Target: confirm fail-closed top-level control, valid loop behavior, diagnostic stability, and no adjacent semantic expansion. Constraints & Risks: the Reviewer runs exactly once; repairs without product trade-offs remain in scope; full regression runs only after review.
conditions: No unresolved immediate decision issue may remain before full regression.

interfaces.inputs: completed verifier implementation and focused evidence
interfaces.outputs: reviewed closure with passing impacted regression
